Synchronous fan-out

Survives unchanged

OK, SKIPPED, DEGRADED outcomes

span.p:
2000 RPS times 2 providers is
4000 outbound calls per second,
over APIs we cannot renegotiate,
from a vendor failing about 1 call in 3
